description: This is a controller class for handling location-related actions within the 'OrangeHRM' human resource management system. The class manages rendering logic for location views, including setting up components and permissions based on HTTP request attributes.

classes.name: SaveLocationController
classes.description: A controller for saving and editing location data in the OrangeHRM system, extending the BaseAdminController to include permission setting and component rendering logic.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component for location editing or creation based on the request, and sets permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required to check user capabilities related to locations.
